messages:
zoe.design: quick keyboard + SR pass on the Models dashboard. Found a few small, actionable items: focus movement, kebab tabbability under virtualization, duplicated header announcements, and low-contrast pills. posting repros and suggestions.
kai.frontend: thanks — paste steps and Ill take the DOM changes.
nana.a11y: high level: ensure roving focus moves DOM focus, kebab must be reachable via Tab even when rows are virtualized, remove redundant aria-labelledby causing double header reads, and bump pill contrast.
zoe.design: 1) Using arrow keys moves the visual selection but browser focus stays on the list container; keyboard users lose the focus ring. repro: Console > Models, press Down Arrow twice. suggestion: implement roving tabindex (tabindex=-1 on non-selected, tabindex=0 + focus() on selected) and use :focus-visible for keyboard-only rings.
kai.frontend: noted — we were toggling aria-selected only. I'll add tabindex switching and focus() calls.
nana.a11y: prefer the primary focusable child to be semantic (link/button) so SR reads the label.
zoe.design: 2) Kebab (More) buttons are skipped in Tab order for many virtual rows. Tabbing jumps past until the row is interacted with. repro: Tab from top, many kebabs never receive focus. suggestion: keep one real tabbable control per logical row; mark visual-only clones aria-hidden but keep the tabbable control.
kai.frontend: virtualization fix is needed — I'll ensure kebab remains in DOM with tabindex=0 and toggle visual clones.
leo.qa: I'll add an e2e that tabs across 12 rows and asserts each kebab gets focused.
zoe.design: 3) Screen readers sometimes announce the column header twice on the first cell (e.g., "Name, Models, row 3 of 8, Name"). Likely duplicated aria-labelledby.
nana.a11y: audit and remove redundant labelledby references; prefer aria-describedby for extra info. Ensure role pairing if using grid semantics.
kai.frontend: will strip extra labelledby and re-run VO/NVDA checks.
zoe.design: 4) Status pills (experimental/deprecated) are low contrast at small sizes (~2.6:1). suggestion: add semantic tokens (e.g., --status-pill-text) and pick darker text or slightly darker bg to reach at least 3:1 (4.5:1 preferred).
kai.frontend: will propose token swaps and post before/after screens. also can consider semi-bold text if color change is constrained.
nana.a11y: minor copy nit: kebab aria-label is generic "More" — use `aria-label="More actions for ${model.name}"` so controls are contextual.
kai.frontend: agreed, will set aria-label dynamically. splitting into two PRs: (A) roving focus + kebab tabbability (P0) in 3 business days, (B) pill tokens + labelledby cleanup (P1) next week.
zoe.design: thanks team — attaching token sketches and a couple of screenshots in the PR thread.
